notes.title: 🚨 ULTRAKILL CROSSOVER update! 🚨
notes.content:

[b]⚔️ What is Boss Rush Mode? ⚔️ [/b]

Face a relentless sequence of bosses in a race against time. The faster you defeat them, the higher you'll climb on the global leaderboards. Show off your skills and claim your spot at the top! 

[b]💀 ULTRAKILLER Spoiler:[/b]The final showdown in Boss Rush Mode features a special boss straight from ULTRAKILL! Yes, one of the most iconic villains from its ultraviolent universe is here, specially designed for this mode, ready to push your skills to the limit. Can you conquer this epic battle?

notes.title: WEEK 1 PATCH 1.01
notes.content:
This patch is a small one focused on the most immediate matters about the launch week that we detected.

[b]PATCH NOTES:
[/b]
- V-SYNC added to options. Marked off by default. It may fix some issues with frame drops.

- STEAM DECK saves: Fixed bugs between save interactions carried out from pc to steamdeck and vice versa messing up with the game.

- DOOR LOCKER UPGRADE: Bug that inactivates it in some instances.

- YELLOW SHOES achievement not triggering even if you pick the shoes. (ALL SHOES ACHIEVEMENTS WILL BE DOUBLE CHECKED WHEN YOU ENTER CONTROLS IN OPTIONS.)

- MORE LENIENT PITS: Now you don't die on a pit, but teleport to the beginning of the pit section as a punishment.

- Shop screen mouselock fixed.

- FINISH ITEMS UNUSABLE fixed.

- RIFLE not appearing on endless and permadeath was fixed. (You can get the rifle as a prize in the unboxing.)

- WEAPONS UPGRADE SYSTEM: now better communicated to the player.

- HANDHELD devices that are not steamdeck - legion go and similar - now we have resolutions on portrait mode.

- The game now autosaves only between stages to increase security.

- DECALS of WEAPONS optimized.

- Some scenario collisions fixed.

- POLISH CHARACTERS ADDED

- Lots of language fixes.

- Lots of small fixes.

[b]KNOWN ISSUES FOR NEXT PATCHES:
[/b]

- Performance drops after play the game for some time being addressed with caution and care.

- DECAL optimization for other weapons and decal bugs on the last section.

- MENU OPTIONS for Jack and streamer talking, skipping tutorials and hints, timescale slider?

- Revised Japanese and Chinese.

- Characters for Ukrainian.

- Small visual and usability bugs.

notes.title: NEW PACTH V0.86 F18b
notes.content:
BUILD V0.86 F18b

 - New compression solution - game now has less than 3GBs

- new difficulty screen, difficulty now has been reworked

- new difficulty called challenge for those who think normal is too easy

- shotgun nerfed a little

- boss atacks improved

- now hard and permadeath has no soda machines and less items to increase fun and challenge.

- improved rank system for those who wanted reasons to kill more enemies

- you can now jump and air dash on the slow ramps (for speedrunners)

- hidden mechanics like HARD having less bonus points for actions and double damage from bosses are now on description of these options, not hidden anymore.  

- screen flahses and shakes now have sliders for more variety of options

- new option - Color Saturation for those who want stream the game and have problems with bitrate.  

- new option - SHOW HUD - for those who know how the game works and dont want hud. 

- TONS of smalls bug fixes 

- To participate helping us to improve the game, talk to us on discord!
